evidence_examined: docker-compose.prod.yaml vault service (environment, volumes, healthcheck, ports)
config/nginx.conf (for any vault upstream config - none found)

tls_certificate_state.setup_secrets_sh_instruction: User must generate: config/vault-tls/vault.crt + vault.key + ca.crt

findings.nginx_upstream_for_vault: NONE - nginx.conf has no upstream or proxy config for Vault

contradictions.description: vault.hcl listener has tls_disable=true (HTTP), but api_addr and cluster_addr specify https:// scheme

contradictions.category: Listener TLS vs Docker Compose Environment
contradictions.description: vault.hcl listener is HTTP (tls_disable=true), but VAULT_ADDR/VAULT_API_ADDR/VAULT_CLUSTER_ADDR env vars all use https:// scheme
Healthcheck uses 'vault status -tls-skip-verify' which implies HTTPS is expected (the flag is only needed for HTTPS with self-signed certs), but listener is HTTP

contradictions.category: TLS Volume Mount vs Certificate State
contradictions.description: docker-compose mounts ./config/vault-tls:/vault/tls:ro but the directory is empty - Vault would fail to start if TLS were actually enabled

contradictions.category: API Service VAULT_ADDR vs Vault Listener
contradictions.description: api service environment sets VAULT_ADDR=https://vault:8200, but Vault listener is HTTP on 8200 - API cannot connect via HTTPS

Config says 'Production Configuration' but uses tls_disable=true (insecure HTTP). setup-secrets.sh instructs user to generate TLS certs for vault-tls/, implying HTTPS intent. These are mutually exclusive states.

required_conditions.condition: If production intent is HTTPS: vault.hcl must have tls_disable=false, tls_cert_file and tls_key_file pointing to /vault/tls/vault.crt and /vault/tls/vault.key, and certs must exist in config/vault-tls/

If production intent is HTTP: vault.hcl api_addr and cluster_addr must use http:// scheme, docker-compose env vars must use http://, api service VAULT_ADDR must use http://, healthcheck must NOT use -tls-skip-verify
Certificate files must exist in config/vault-tls/ before deployment if HTTPS is intended
nginx.conf has no Vault upstream - if external access to Vault is needed, nginx upstream and server block must be added

risks_unknowns.risk: Vault may fail to start if TLS is enabled but certificates are missing from mounted volume
API service will fail to connect to Vault (connection refused or TLS handshake failure) due to scheme mismatch

Healthcheck uses -tls-skip-verify which bypasses certificate validation - if TLS is enabled with self-signed certs, this works but is insecure; if TLS is disabled, the flag is unnecessary but harmless
risks_unknowns.impact: False health status or security degradation

risks_unknowns.risk: Cluster communication (port 8201) also has scheme mismatch - cluster_addr is https but listener is HTTP
risks_unknowns.impact: Raft clustering will fail in multi-node setup

risks_unknowns.risk: No documentation/spec clarifies whether production Vault should be HTTP or HTTPS - this is a fundamental architecture decision
risks_unknowns.impact: Cannot determine correct fix without human decision
